segments.Všetci spracovatelia sú viazaní zmluvou: All processors are bound by a data processing agreement or equivalent safeguards under the GDPR. segments.<strong>Na prístup</strong> — požiadať o: Right of access — you can request a copy of your personal data
segments.<strong>Na opravu</strong> — požiadať o: Right to rectification — you can request the correction of inaccurate data
segments.<strong>Na vymazanie</strong> — požiadať: Right to erasure — you can request the deletion of your data (the “right to be forgotten”)
segments.<strong>Na prenosnosť</strong> — získať: Right to data portability — you can receive your data in a machine-readable format
segments.<strong>Namietať</strong> — namietať spr: Right to object — you can object to processing based on legitimate interest, and to being approached with offers (direct marketing) at any time and without giving reasons
segments.<strong>Odvolať súhlas</strong> — kedyko: Right to withdraw consent — you can withdraw your consent to cookies at any time
segments.Žiadosť o uplatnenie práv posielajte na:: Please send requests to exercise your rights to: office@axiona-group.sk
segments.Máte tiež právo podať sťažnosť na Úrad n: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic: www.uoou.sk, or with the supervisory authority in the EU country where you live or work.

segments.Vaše údaje chránime technickými a organi: We protect your data with technical and organisational measures — encrypted transmission (HTTPS), restricted access and regular security checks.
